title: Evidence store, and the authority gate wired to it
note: I6 was half a guarantee until this store existed: check() required evidence to LOOK like a digest, so '"a" * 64' -- a well-formed digest of nothing -- was accepted. These mutations delete the checks that close that hole and the checks that keep the store from trusting its own directory layout.

mutations.name: E1_no_read_verification
mutations.rationale: the store would hand back whatever bytes sit at the path, which is the whole attack

mutations.name: E2_follow_symlinks_in_store
mutations.rationale: a link's target is chosen by whoever can write the directory, not by the digest

mutations.name: E3_read_non_regular_files
mutations.rationale: a FIFO planted in the store would block the read forever

mutations.name: E4_accept_any_digest_string
mutations.rationale: path traversal is impossible only because the digest shape is validated first

mutations.name: E5_no_put_size_bound
mutations.rationale: an unbounded put is a memory-exhaustion path

mutations.name: E6_no_read_size_bound
mutations.rationale: a bound lowered after content was stored would not be honoured on read

mutations.name: E7_contains_skips_verification
mutations.rationale: an unverified containment check answers 'is there a file there', which is the question a tamperer wants asked

mutations.name: E8_put_file_follows_symlink
mutations.rationale: the bytes of an unrelated file would be stored under a name the caller chose

mutations.name: E9_put_file_reads_non_regular
mutations.rationale: put_file on a FIFO would hang instead of refusing

mutations.name: E10_put_file_ignores_size_bound
mutations.rationale: an oversized file would be read entirely into memory before being refused

mutations.name: E11_info_size_from_sidecar
mutations.replace: return BlobInfo(dgs, int(json.loads(self._meta_path(dgs).read_text())['size']) if self._meta_path(dgs).is_file() else len(content), media_type, first_seen)
mutations.rationale: an auditor could be told a 40-byte report is 4 GB; the sidecar is as writable as the blob

mutations.name: E12_require_resolvable_never_resolves
mutations.rationale: every citation would resolve, so I6 would be syntactic again

mutations.name: E13_put_rewrites_existing_blob
mutations.rationale: stored evidence would be silently replaced, erasing what a prior citation referred to

mutations.name: E14_meta_overwritten_on_second_put
mutations.rationale: first-seen would be restated by any later put, losing when the store learned the evidence

mutations.name: E15_non_bytes_payload_accepted
mutations.rationale: a digest would be taken over an undefined byte sequence

mutations.name: E16_verify_store_ignores_stray_names
mutations.rationale: a store audit would pass over files it cannot account for

mutations.name: E17_list_digests_yields_stray_names
mutations.rationale: a caller iterating the store would receive a string it could mistake for a digest

mutations.name: E18_gate_ignores_the_resolver
mutations.rationale: the gate would accept a fabricated citation even with a store attached

mutations.name: E19_store_skips_creation_time_resolution
mutations.rationale: a fabricated citation would become a permanent hash-chained fact before anyone noticed

mutations.name: E20_store_never_passes_a_resolver
mutations.find: return None if self.evidence is None else self.evidence.contains
mutations.rationale: attaching an evidence store would have no effect at all
